cover: Where your cloud bill actually goes

slides.title: Compute is rarely the problem
slides.body: The cost is egress, capacity reserved for a rare peak, and managed services priced for a bigger company.

slides.title: Start with an inventory
slides.body: Every workload either moves as it is, needs a bridge, or stays where it is.

slides.title: Files move to R2
slides.body: Same S3 API, no egress fees. For apps that serve files, that alone is often the business case.

slides.title: Servers become Workers
slides.body: Billed per request and scaled to zero when traffic is quiet, with nothing sized for peak.

slides.title: Some things should stay
slides.body: GPU workloads, long-running stateful services and hard-won compliance boundaries stay, with Cloudflare in front.

slides.title: Cut over route by route
slides.body: Routes move one at a time behind the DNS you already have, and users keep the same URLs.
